name: com.girikgarg.preferencesutility
description: Visual editor and C# code generator for PlayerPrefs and EditorPrefs. Define preferences in version-controlled .prefsdef assets, set defaults in the Editor, and get strongly typed, zero-reflection accessors for every built-in C# and Unity type plus any custom type (serialized with Newtonsoft Json). Includes a live viewer for all PlayerPrefs and EditorPrefs.
